functional_semantics.triton: Grouped 2-D cross-correlation, no bias, isotropic stride/padding passed as h/w pairs (178-181), zero padding by masking, out_H/out_W floor formula (impl_triton.py 44-47, 63-80, 160-161).
functional_semantics.cutile: Same semantics: flattened (ic_local, kh, kw) reduction, clamp+mask zero padding, same out_H/out_W (impl_cutile.py 56-59, 76-112, 177-178, 195-196).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise F.conv2d(input, weight, bias=None, stride, padding, groups) (impl_torch.py 7-14); output (batch, out_channels, out_H, out_W) in the input dtype.

stages.triton: torch.empty output (164) then one implicit-GEMM kernel launch over (ceil(batch*out_H*out_W/rows), ceil(Cout_g/cols), groups) (impl_triton.py 199-223).
stages.cutile: torch.empty output (181-182), flat views (184-186), one implicit-GEMM kernel launch with the same 3-axis grid (impl_cutile.py 228-237).
stages.note: Identical single-kernel structure; no im2col, no padded copy, no second pass.

dependencies.triton: Output tiles independent; only the in-program sequential reduction loop (impl_triton.py 59-105).
dependencies.note: No inter-program dependency on either side.

reduction_scan_sort.triton: Sequential loop over Cin_g*kH*kW flattened channel-major, then kh, then kw; chunks folded by tl.dot into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K/atomics (impl_triton.py 58-65, 105).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: Same flattening (76-78) and sequential chunk loop folded by ct.mma into one fp32 accumulator; no split-K/atomics (impl_cutile.py 72-78, 132-133).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Same reduction structure and enumeration order.

precision.triton: fp32 accumulator (55); tl.dot(..., input_precision="tf32") (105); cast to output dtype at store (116).
precision.cutile: fp32 accumulator (67); operands cast to ct.tfloat32 for fp32 inputs, else native (70, 132-133); cast before scatter (154).
precision.note: Same precision class: TF32 operands for fp32, fp32 accumulation, output in input dtype. config.yaml verify atol 1e-1 / rtol 1e-2, with a tolerance-only CDNA3 override to atol 2e-1 (config.yaml 6-11) that is not a code branch in either implementation.

preprocessing.triton: Contiguity asserts and scalar metadata only (155-162); no cast/transpose/pack; nothing cached (impl_triton.py 155-197).
preprocessing.cutile: Contiguity asserts, scalar metadata, zero-copy .view(-1) (172-186); nothing cached (impl_cutile.py 172-202).

intermediate_storage.cutile: None; accumulator in tile space, output written once via scatter (impl_cutile.py 67, 155).
intermediate_storage.note: No global scratch on either side.

mutation.triton: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_triton.py 164).
mutation.cutile: No input written; output freshly allocated per call (impl_cutile.py 181-182).
mutation.note: Idempotent on both sides; contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.triton: No architecture branch in impl_triton.py; the CDNA3 entry lives in config.yaml verify.arch_overrides (tolerance only).
hardware_dispatch.note: Neither implementation dispatches on hardware; the config-level tolerance override affects verification only.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: batch * in_channels * H * H * dtype_size + out_channels * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size ** 2 * dtype_size + batch * out_channels * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * dtype_size
fq_boundary.flops_expr: 2 * batch * out_channels * ((H + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1) ** 2 * (in_channels // groups) * kernel_size ** 2
fq_boundary.note: config.yaml 35-43. Assumes W = H and a square kernel as the generator guarantees (tensors.py 471-476). Counts one read of input and weight, one write of output and 2 flops per MAC; both run() bodies contain only metadata, an uninitialised output allocation and one kernel. Cache re-reads of overlapping windows are uncounted on both sides equally.
